see_for_yourself.expected: The overlap shows 2 of 3 free; the rehearsal warns that Pianist isn't free, and confirming still works.
steps: Move or delete project/data, then cd project && corepack pnpm run dev --host
Create a group and join it as Cellist and Pianist in two private windows
Give the organizer and Cellist Thursday 19:00 to 22:00 availability
As organizer open Schedule, tap Propose this time on next Thursday, add Studio B and propose
see_for_yourself.title: Warn, then confirm

see_for_yourself.expected: The warning disappears once Pianist is optional; Cellist sees counts, then names after the switch.
steps: On the group page tap Make optional for Pianist
Switch What members see, then open Schedule from Cellist's window
see_for_yourself.title: Optional members and privacy

what_just_landed.detail: Each group's Schedule shows, for the next eight weeks, when people are free: counts for members, names when the organizer allows it, and for organizers who is missing.
what_just_landed.title: Schedule page

what_just_landed.detail: Organizers propose one-off or weekly rehearsals with a location, straight from a free stretch, and confirm them later; members see both lists.
what_just_landed.title: Propose and confirm rehearsals

what_just_landed.detail: Each rehearsal warns organizers which non-optional members aren't free on which dates; confirming still works.
what_just_landed.title: Warnings that never block

what_just_landed.detail: On the group page organizers tag members optional, make other members organizers and choose whether members see names.
what_just_landed.title: Organizer controls
